_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / tool-rendering-custom-catchall. Holds ONLY the two d5-tool-rendering-custom-catchall probe turns: "Forecast Tokyo through the wildcard renderer" (get_weather) at turnIndex 0/2 and "Quote AAPL through the wildcard renderer" (get_stock_price) at turnIndex 3/5, both in ONE thread. The page's four suggestion pills ("What's the weather in San Francisco?", "Find flights from SFO to JFK.", "Roll a 20-sided die.", "Chain a few tools in this single turn: ...") are worded identically to the tool-rendering page's pills and are served from d6/google-antigravity/tool-rendering.json — this file must NOT duplicate them: it loads FIRST alphabetically, so a copy here shadows the owning file for every one of the three tool-rendering pages. Backend tools execute on the Antigravity harness and return real JSON results, which the wildcard renderer surfaces in the result block.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: google-antigravity staging: the Antigravity Go harness owns the conversation history and never sends role:"tool" messages -- a completed tool call comes back as an assistant message whose text is 'Tool response for <name>: ...'. hasToolResult/toolCallId therefore never fire here, so every leg is staged on turnIndex (aimock's count of assistant messages; +2 per tool round-trip, +1 per text answer). turnIndex is a POSITION disambiguator, not a reject gate (aimock selectByTurnIndex): the candidate with the highest turnIndex <= assistantCount wins, so a leg must carry EVERY absolute position a test can reach it from -- a fresh thread (0/2) AND its slot in a multi-pill single-thread sequence.
